options.tool: paddleocr 3.7.0 PaddleOCRVL (the documented Python object), kept loaded by paddleocr_vl_service.py
options.arguments: the production adapter's PaddleOCRVL(...) and predict(...) arguments, as Python arguments (paddleocr_vl_service.construct_kwargs, PREDICT_KWARGS)
options.page_selection: none: one-page sources only; a source the object reads as more than one page is the failure row page_count_unsupported
options.layout_model: PP-DocLayoutV3, the layout model PaddleX 3.7.0-3.7.2 names for pipeline PaddleOCR-VL-1.6; its directory is passed, its name is the pipeline config's (as production)
options.doc_preprocessor: off: orientation (PP-LCNet_x1_0_doc_ori) and unwarping (UVDoc) switched off by use_doc_orientation_classify=False and use_doc_unwarping=False, so neither model is loaded
options.model_load: once, when the service starts; a page's time is its request
